metadata.name: One and Done Double Bloom
metadata.author: Lance Hedrick
metadata.description: Double bloom technique for maximum extraction clarity. Two short blooms fully saturate the bed before a single aggressive centre pour. Grind finer than typical (target 2:00–2:30 draw down). Use 93–96°C for light roasts, 90–93°C for medium, lower for darker roasts. 1:15 ratio.

protocol.notes: Pour 45g (3× dose) at 5–10 ml/s — first bloom to wet all grounds
Wait until 0:30 — let first bloom degas
Pour to 90g at 5–10 ml/s — second bloom for full saturation
Wait until 1:00 — let second bloom settle
Pour to 225g at 9–10 ml/s in coin-sized circles in the centre — single aggressive main pour
Gentle Rao spin to level the bed
